messages:
aisha_k: FYI seeing weird numbers in the console for tiered routing. Lots of requests showing up as "fallback_variant=v2-quant" but no indication that a tier override header was present. anyone else?
ben_p: can you paste a sample request or the SDK flags you used? quick guess: SDK sometimes omits X-Redwood-Tier when implicit.
aisha_k: repro curl below — we pass regional + tier override. still shows primary model hits zero, fallback counts non-zero.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-alpha-3","input":"hello"}'
```
dmitri_r: console groups by model id (rw-alpha-3) and then by model_variant when variant metadata is present. if variant metadata is missing telemetry backend silently attributes to the fallback_variant field instead of the header. that causes the skew.
emily_s: I reproduced. If route negotiation falls back at the routing layer, the header sometimes gets overwritten by the gateway with `fallback_variant`. we should log the original requested tier in a separate telemetry field so console can show requested vs actual.
ben_p: agree. we can add a new header to propagate original intent: `X-RW-Requested-Tier`. SDKs can set it once and gateway should not mutate it. would also help audits.
aisha_k: +1. also want a lightweight debug flag for customers to include in requests so we can capture routing decisions per-request without enabling full traces. maybe `X-RW-Debug: routing-probe=1`
dmitri_r: we already have a debug header `X-RW-Debug:route_probe=1` in the internal SDK, but it doesn't surface to the console. telemetry pipeline drops it for PII reasons. can we whitelist a non-sensitive routing-probe flag?
emily_s: proposed plan: 1) SDKs set `X-RW-Requested-Tier` when tier param is used. 2) Gateway adds `route_decision` metadata to the request event with fields: `resolved_region`, `resolved_variant`, `fallback_reason`. 3) console UI shows an optional toggle "show routing probe" that includes those fields. 4) Add `X-RW-Debug: routing-probe=1` that customers can opt into; routed requests with that header get full routing_decision payload for 7 days.
ben_p: implementation notes: backend event schema change + index cost. keep routing_decision compact: short enum strings not long traces. whitelist only for orgs with telemetry retention paid tier.
telemetry-bot: new events pipeline PR #382 opened by @dmitri_r — adds `requested_tier` and `routing_decision` to model_request events. CI tests failing for indexing.
deploy-bot: staging deploy for telemetry-patch started at 2026-03-19T21:05:00Z, rollback triggered due to index size spike.
aisha_k: thanks — can we also make console alert when fallback rate > 5% for tiered customers? ops teams want early warning.
emily_s: we'll add a per-org rule and a quick graph in the model route dashboard. I can mock the UI strings in the next UX pass.
dmitri_r: backfill note: existing events won't have requested_tier; we should backfill from traces where available but call it best-effort. be explicit in the console about missing data.
aisha_k: perfect. will follow up with a short RFC for `X-RW-Requested-Tier` and `routing-probe` handling. thanks all :thumbsup:
